as_of_semantics: date of last real content edit, verified from git history during the Round 26 as_of consistency audit; it is not a validity or freshness guarantee
purpose: Define the minimum handoff and stop-accountability fields for eight concept projects and three first-test protocols without assigning unconfirmed organisations, budgets, sites or results.

authority_boundary.rule: A role label is a vacancy to be confirmed through the applicable public, owner, operator and professional process; it is not evidence that an institution has accepted responsibility.

records.name: Six-gateway accessible stitching

raci.accountable_role: public-realm approval owner to be confirmed

approval_triggers: park, road and railway interface permissions where applicable
prohibited_data: facial templates
identity-linked route histories
disability inference without explicit consent
records.incident_and_stop_responsibility: The confirmed on-site operator must have immediate physical stop authority; the accountable public-realm owner decides restart after accessibility and safety review.
stop_conditions: an accessible route is narrowed or blocked
a non-AI alternative is unavailable
wayfinding causes a safety-critical misroute
records.recovery_plan: Remove temporary equipment and markings, restore the pre-pilot accessible path, publish the break-point record and re-audit before any restart.
records.community_co_test: Complete the same route task with wheelchair users, visually impaired users, older people, caregivers and ordinary pedestrians in both AI and non-AI modes.
records.independent_retest: An accessibility reviewer independent of the delivery team repeats the critical route and stop-condition tests.
records.go_no_go: NO-GO until the route is verified in the field, the responsible operator accepts stop duty, and every critical break has a continuous non-AI alternative.

records.name: Reversible time-space park

raci.accountable_role: park and public-space owner role to be confirmed
informed_roles: daily park users and event participants

approval_triggers: ecology, drainage, heritage and fire review
event, temporary-structure and night-operation permissions as applicable
prohibited_data: continuous identifiable visitor tracking
biometric emotion inference
minor profiles
records.incident_and_stop_responsibility: The confirmed park operator stops a mode or event immediately; specialist owners decide ecological, drainage, heritage or safety recovery before restart.
stop_conditions: loss of quiet or step-free access beyond the published limit
habitat, drainage or heritage damage
crowding exceeds the approved operating envelope
records.recovery_plan: Return the area to its documented daily mode, remove reversible installations, repair affected surfaces or planting, and keep the event offline until independent acceptance.
records.community_co_test: Residents and daily users compare daily, learning, beta, quiet and offline modes, including no-event and no-screen options.
records.independent_retest: An independent public-space and accessibility reviewer verifies restoration and mode-switch performance.
records.go_no_go: NO-GO for any added layer that cannot prove incremental public value, a no-build alternative, no net loss of accessible public space and a funded restoration route.

records.name: Zhongzhiyuan verification commons

raci.accountable_role: test-site legal and safety owner to be confirmed
informed_roles: affected site users and test participants

approval_triggers: confirmed legal test site and responsible entity
physical safety, fire, network and data review
published emergency, exclusion-zone and insurance requirements
prohibited_data: unconsented biometric data
unbounded public-space audio or video
personal data unrelated to the test hypothesis
records.incident_and_stop_responsibility: The on-site safety operator holds physical emergency-stop authority; the accountable test-site owner controls restart after incident review.
stop_conditions: collision, boundary breach or failed physical emergency stop
loss of human takeover
collection outside the approved data envelope
records.recovery_plan: Isolate the system, preserve a minimised incident record, restore the public area, notify affected parties and restart only from a lower gate after independent review.
records.community_co_test: Invite non-technical observers and affected users to test explanations, exclusion boundaries, stop controls and the ability to opt out.
records.independent_retest: A technically competent reviewer outside the delivery team reproduces safety-critical tests from a fixed package.
records.go_no_go: NO-GO beyond G0 without a legal site, named accountable role, tested physical stop, bounded data specification and independently repeatable protocol.

records.name: Origin open-source co-creation street

raci.accountable_role: venue and programme owner to be confirmed

approval_triggers: copyright, open-source licence and generated-content review
prohibited_data: minor data without guardian and safeguarding basis
source code or datasets without verified licence
participation ranking tied to employment or public benefits
records.incident_and_stop_responsibility: The confirmed programme operator stops publication or participation; the rights and safeguarding owner controls removal and restart.
stop_conditions: rights or consent cannot be demonstrated
withdrawal cannot be honoured
non-technical or non-AI participation is excluded
records.recovery_plan: Unpublish disputed material, honour withdrawal, retain only the minimum audit record, restore the venue and re-open after rights and safeguarding review.
records.community_co_test: Run the same public problem through technical, non-technical and non-AI participation paths with residents and the three published target groups.
records.independent_retest: An independent rights and inclusion reviewer samples provenance, withdrawal and participation-parity records.
records.go_no_go: NO-GO until venue authority, rights provenance, safeguarding, withdrawal and equal non-AI participation are demonstrably available.

records.name: Dazhongsi urban-services portal

raci.accountable_role: public-service and venue owner to be confirmed

approval_triggers: transport, fire, privacy and accessibility review
prohibited_data: identity documents retained outside an authorised transaction
cross-service behavioural profiles
inference of eligibility from conversational data
records.incident_and_stop_responsibility: The staffed service lead suspends an affected answer path; the accountable service owner decides correction, notification and restart.
stop_conditions: an error affects a formal procedure or right
a source is stale without warning
human or non-AI completion is unavailable
records.recovery_plan: Disable the affected answer set, route all tasks to the staffed or published non-AI channel, correct the source pack and retest the fixed question set.
records.community_co_test: Residents, older people, disabled users, commuters and visitors complete the same bounded task through AI, staffed and published non-AI channels.
records.independent_retest: An independent service-quality reviewer repeats the fixed question set, expiry-warning and handoff tests.
records.go_no_go: NO-GO until the accountable service source, current venue, human fallback, non-AI route and formal-error stop process are confirmed.

records.name: Trustworthy narrative double helix

raci.accountable_role: publishing and curatorial owner to be confirmed

prohibited_data: unverified personal allegations
private archives without permission
synthetic media presented as historical evidence
records.incident_and_stop_responsibility: The publishing operator removes disputed content immediately; the accountable curator decides correction or republication after rights and evidence review.
stop_conditions: source or licence cannot be verified
a correction or withdrawal cannot be actioned
AI-generated content lacks required labelling
records.recovery_plan: Withdraw the affected asset, preserve a correction notice, provide an accessible neutral placeholder and republish only after documented review.
records.community_co_test: Contributors and audiences test accuracy, correction, withdrawal, language access and non-screen alternatives.
records.independent_retest: An independent historian or rights reviewer samples claim-to-source and asset-to-licence chains.
records.go_no_go: NO-GO for publication where claim authority, asset rights, AI labelling, correction and accessible alternative media are incomplete.

records.name: Scenario passports and open benchmarks

raci.accountable_role: scenario governance owner to be confirmed

prohibited_data: benchmark data collected outside consent and purpose
hidden protected-attribute scoring
participant identities in public failure reports
records.incident_and_stop_responsibility: The responsible operator suspends the scenario; the governance owner controls gate status and the benchmark custodian records the evidence change.
stop_conditions: passport fields or accountable role are incomplete
benchmark cannot be reproduced
a stop threshold is crossed or source freshness becomes blocking
records.recovery_plan: Downgrade the gate, disable public use, publish the affected evidence scope, correct the package and require independent retest before reinstatement.
records.community_co_test: Community seats review the task definition, harms, parity measures, stop thresholds and publication form before a live test.
records.independent_retest: A separate evaluator executes the versioned benchmark without delivery-team assistance and records deviations.
records.go_no_go: NO-GO beyond G0 until governance ownership, community review, reproducible benchmark, stop thresholds, manual fallback and expiry are confirmed.

records.name: Four-season operations and Proof Week

raci.accountable_role: programme and event owner to be confirmed
informed_roles: participants, residents and affected site users

approval_triggers: confirmed budget, venue, operator and event permission
crowd, fire, accessibility and noise review
prohibited_data: participant ranking tied to employment, wealth or public benefits
unconsented attendee tracking
public incident records containing unnecessary personal data
records.incident_and_stop_responsibility: The event operations lead stops the affected activity; the programme owner decides cancellation or restart after venue and professional review.
stop_conditions: venue safety or crowd limit is crossed
non-participants lose ordinary public access
failure or correction cannot be published as promised
records.recovery_plan: Cancel or shrink the event, return the venue to daily mode, restore ordinary access, publish the decision and retire any unsupported scenario.
records.community_co_test: Residents and daily users review the calendar, quiet periods, access protections, failure-publication format and cancellation route.
records.independent_retest: An independent event-safety and public-interest reviewer samples mode changes, access and published evidence after each cycle.
records.go_no_go: NO-GO without a confirmed operator, budget, venue, daily-use protection, incident stop authority and restoration plan.

records.name: Robot safety graduation protocol

raci.accountable_role: controlled-test safety owner to be confirmed
informed_roles: test participants and affected site users

approval_triggers: hazard, insurance, fire and network review
exclusion boundary and human-takeover procedure approval
prohibited_data: biometric identification unrelated to collision avoidance
public-space data outside the approved test window
secondary use of safety logs without review
records.incident_and_stop_responsibility: The physical emergency-stop operator stops the robot; the accountable safety owner controls quarantine and restart.
stop_conditions: any collision or boundary breach
any failed physical emergency stop
any incomplete human-takeover chain
records.recovery_plan: Power down and isolate the system, restore the test area, preserve a minimised incident log and restart only from a lower gate after root-cause and independent review.
records.community_co_test: Affected users test boundary comprehension, opt-out, audible and visual warning, non-AI route and staff response in a controlled setting.
records.independent_retest: An independent safety evaluator reruns every safety-critical case from the frozen test package.
records.go_no_go: NO-GO to G1 until all proposed hard gates pass in controlled testing; current passed-test count is zero.

records.name: Sourced enterprise-service protocol
approval_triggers: staffed fallback and correction duty accepted
prohibited_data: eligibility decisions inferred from chat history
identity documents outside an authorised workflow
cross-user conversation reuse without consent and legal basis
records.incident_and_stop_responsibility: The staffed-handoff lead disables the affected answer path; the accountable information owner approves correction and restart.
stop_conditions: an error affects a formal procedure
a stale source is presented without warning
refusal or human handoff fails
records.recovery_plan: Route all affected tasks to the official non-AI or staffed channel, freeze the source version, correct the answer set and rerun the complete benchmark.
records.community_co_test: Representative users complete a fixed task set in AI, staffed and published non-AI modes, including refusal and complaint cases.
records.independent_retest: An evaluator outside the content team reruns the fixed question set and verifies citations, expiry warnings, refusals and handoff.
records.go_no_go: NO-GO to bounded service until pre-published coverage, freshness warning, refusal, handoff and non-AI parity thresholds are met; no result is currently claimed.

records.name: Universal-access route protocol

raci.accountable_role: route and accessibility owner to be confirmed

approval_triggers: accessible co-test plan and participant safeguards
operator acceptance of immediate route closure and repair duty
prohibited_data: disability inference without explicit consent
identity-linked movement history
public comparison of identifiable participant performance
records.incident_and_stop_responsibility: The on-site marshal closes the affected route or tool; the accountable route owner controls repair and restart.
stop_conditions: any critical break lacks a non-AI alternative
a participant is exposed to unmanaged safety risk
task success worsens materially for a tested group
records.recovery_plan: Return to the verified non-AI route, remove misleading guidance, correct the break and repeat the complete multi-group test before reopening.
records.community_co_test: Wheelchair users, visually impaired users, older people, caregivers and ordinary pedestrians complete the same consented task in AI and non-AI modes.
records.independent_retest: An accessibility reviewer independent of the design team repeats all critical route and parity cases.
evidence_deliverables: group-level task outcomes with privacy protection
records.go_no_go: NO-GO to G1 while any critical break lacks a non-AI alternative; no field test or group outcome is currently claimed.
